svg.title: The last page of bank $00, byte by byte
svg.desc: A 16 by 16 grid of the 256 bytes from $00:FF00 to $00:FFFF, coloured by what they hold: the 7-byte reset stub at $FF00, unused $FF fill to $FF0F, the NMI and IRQ stubs at $FF10-$FF17, the BRK handler at $FF18-$FF1D, two unused bytes, the 8-byte BitSet and BitClear tables at $FF20-$FF2F, the two 64-byte scroll wave tables at $FF30-$FFAF, the cartridge header at $FFB0-$FFDF and the interrupt vectors at $FFE0-$FFFF. The RESET vector at $FFFC points back to $FF00.
